caption: The drawing is composed in grayscale pencil and features a large, detailed depiction of a creamer jug with a prominent, rounded body, a wide poured lip, and an angular handle. The jug has a decorative band around its upper middle featuring a pattern of floral and geometric motifs. It stands on a pedestal base that is wide and is square-shaped at the bottom. In the lower left corner, there is an emblem with a decorative oval frame formed by interlaced branches, inside of which are the script letters "HB." To the lower right of the large central image, there is a smaller, simplified outline of the same creamer jug, lacking the decorative details of the main sketch. The name "D. BRANDFIELD" is written in capital letters in the bottom right corner of the drawing. The background is plain, and the shading is soft and even, with no colors except for slight aging or discoloration visible on the paper.
title: Silver Pitcher
